summary: Verified the P0 bug fix for 'business analyst' + 'Toronto' search on Quality Sources. The fix in JobSearch.jsx line 259 (changing /api/jobs/search to /api/jobs/greenhouse/search in performFallbackSearch) is working correctly. Backend fallback mechanism returns 16+ related analyst jobs when strict search returns 0.

Backend: Strict search for 'business analyst' in 'Toronto' returns 0 jobs (expected)
Backend: Backend sends suggest_fallback=true when 0 results for multi-word query
Backend: Fallback search (fallback_search=true) returns 25+ related analyst jobs
Backend: Fallback jobs include match_score, match_recommendation, match_strengths, match_gaps
Backend: Single-word query 'analyst' uses broad matching without fallback
Backend: Location matching includes Canada and Remote for Toronto searches
Frontend: Job search page loads with authentication
Frontend: Quality Boards source selector works
Frontend: Search triggers SSE streaming from /api/jobs/greenhouse/search
Frontend: Fallback automatically triggered when strict search returns 0
Frontend: Console shows 'No exact matches found. Searching for related roles...'
Frontend: 16 related job cards displayed after fallback
Frontend: Job cards show match scores (75% Match) and recommendations (Good Match)
Frontend: Jobs are from Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby (quality sources)
Frontend: Jobs are in Canada/Toronto area
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified: Line 259 in JobSearch.jsx now correctly uses /api/jobs/greenhouse/search instead of /api/jobs/search
Backend logging improved: Line 811 logs fallback_search flag value
Fallback mechanism working: Lines 1044-1048 send suggest_fallback when 0 results for multi-word query
seed_data_creation: Created test user with Business Analyst profile: skills (SQL, Excel, Tableau, JIRA, Agile, Data Analysis), job_titles (Business Analyst, Data Analyst), preferred_locations (Toronto, Canada), experience_years (5), work_authorization (canadian_citizen)
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 bug fix verified. The fallback search mechanism is working correctly. When searching 'business analyst' in 'Toronto' on Quality Sources: 1) Strict search returns 0 exact matches, 2) Backend sends suggest_fallback=true, 3) Frontend triggers performFallbackSearch with fallback_search=true, 4) Backend returns 16+ related analyst jobs (Data Analyst, Fraud Analyst, etc.) from Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby. Test session valid for 7 days.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: performFallbackSearch function in JobSearch.jsx was calling /api/jobs/search (JSearch aggregator API) instead of /api/jobs/greenhouse/search (streaming Greenhouse/Lever endpoint). This meant the fallback mode (which correctly uses relaxed keyword matching) was never being used for Quality Sources.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed line 259 in JobSearch.jsx from '/api/jobs/search' to '/api/jobs/greenhouse/search'
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Tested end-to-end: strict search returns 0 → suggest_fallback sent → fallback triggered → 16+ related jobs returned
